mapper.select: SELECT c.collection_id , c.owner_id , c.title , c.description , c.emoji , c.category , c.is_public , c.created_at , c.updated_at , u.nickname AS owner_nickname , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS place_count FROM collections c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.owner_id WHERE c.collection_id = #{collectionId}

SELECT c.collection_id , c.owner_id , c.title , c.description , c.emoji , c.category , c.is_public , c.created_at , u.nickname AS owner_nickname , m.role , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS place_count , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_favorites f WHERE f.collection_id = c.collection_id AND f.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_favorite FROM collections c JOIN collection_members m ON m.collection_id = c.collection_id AND m.user_id = #{userId} JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.owner_id ORDER BY is_favorite DESC, c.updated_at DESC

SELECT c.collection_id , c.owner_id , c.title , c.description , c.emoji , c.category , c.created_at , u.nickname AS owner_nickname , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM places p WHERE p.collection_id = c.collection_id) AS place_count FROM collections c JOIN users u ON u.user_id = c.owner_id WHERE c.is_public = 'Y'
AND (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
